findings.issue: The doc says "Command 1 prints `Tests  4 passed` (the rest of the file skipped). Its four passing cases are ..." and names four cases. The current suite has five cases under the describe 'review divergent pivot under the expansive depth mode'. The fifth is 'still rejects a frontier seed whose free-text scope asks for a change'. Command 1 now prints `Tests  5 passed | 23 skipped (28)`. The Pass rule asks for 'the expected counts', so an operator who follows the doc marks a correct build as FAIL. The count needs to read 5 and the case list needs the fifth case.
